title: KLF4 Induces Mesenchymal-Epithelial Transition (MET) by Suppressing Multiple EMT-Inducing Transcription Factors.
authors: Subbalakshmi, Ayalur Raghu; Sahoo, Sarthak; McMullen, Isabelle; Saxena, Aaditya Narayan; Venugopal, Sudhanva Kalasapura; Somarelli, Jason A; Jolly, Mohit Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文用机制性数学模型研究KLF4通过抑制多个EMT-TF调控上皮-间质可塑性，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但无蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Epithelial-Mesenchymal Plasticity (EMP) refers to reversible dynamic processes where cells can transition from epithelial to mesenchymal (EMT) or from mesenchymal to epithelial (MET) phenotypes. Both these processes are modulated by multiple transcription factors acting in concert. While EMT-inducing transcription factors (TFs)-TWIST1/2, ZEB1/2, SNAIL1/2/3, GSC, and FOXC2-are well-characterized, the MET-inducing TFs are relatively poorly understood (OVOL1/2 and GRHL1/2). Here, using mechanism-based mathematical modeling, we show that transcription factor KLF4 can delay the onset of EMT by suppressing multiple EMT-TFs. Our simulations suggest that KLF4 overexpression can promote a phenotypic shift toward a more epithelial state, an observation suggested by the negative correlation of KLF4 with EMT-TFs and with transcriptomic-based EMT scoring metrics in cancer cell lines. We also show that the influence of KLF4 in modulating the EMT dynamics can be strengthened by its ability to inhibit cell-state transitions at the epigenetic level. Thus, KLF4 can inhibit EMT through multiple parallel paths and can act as a putative MET-TF. KLF4 associates with the patient survival metrics across multiple cancers in a context-specific manner, highlighting the complex association of EMP with patient survival.
abstract_zh: 上皮-间质可塑性（Epithelial-Mesenchymal Plasticity, EMP）指的是细胞能够在上皮表型与间质表型之间可逆转换的动态过程，即上皮-间质转化（EMT）或间质-上皮转化（MET）。这两个过程均受多种转录因子协同调控。尽管诱导EMT的转录因子（TFs）——TWIST1/2、ZEB1/2、SNAIL1/2/3、GSC和FOXC2——已被充分表征，但诱导MET的转录因子（如OVOL1/2和GRHL1/2）相对了解较少。在此，我们利用基于机制的数学模型，表明转录因子KLF4可通过抑制多种EMT-TFs来延迟EMT的发生。我们的模拟结果提示，KLF4过表达可促进细胞向更上皮状态表型转变，这一观察与癌细胞系中KLF4与EMT-TFs及基于转录组的EMT评分指标的负相关性一致。我们还表明，KLF4在调节EMT动态中的作用可通过其在表观遗传水平抑制细胞状态转换的能力得到增强。因此，KLF4可通过多条平行途径抑制EMT，并可能作为潜在的MET-TF发挥作用。KLF4与多种癌症中患者生存指标以情境特异性的方式相关联，突显了EMP与患者生存之间的复杂关联。
